note: 7-day sweep across LinkedIn (Google/Bing-indexed only), Indeed, ZipRecruiter, Glassdoor, ACC Jobline, Legal.io, The Mom Project, Major Lindsey & Africa, and Larson Maddox. Most surface results were aggregator/salary pages (ZipRecruiter salary data, Indeed flexible-jobs hubs, Glassdoor counts) rather than distinct employer briefs. Recent recurring employers (Axiom, Beacon Hill, Latitude Legal, Sleep Doctor, Ontra, Legalpeople, Taylor English, etc.) were deduplicated out against the last 7 days of legal-freelance reports.
